audience: studio owners and front-desk staff who run classes and reservations in Arketa

useCases.title: See which classes are booked this week
useCases.text: List the classes of one week, filtered by location. Open one class to see its time, room, instructor, capacity and booked count.

useCases.title: Check who is booked into one class
useCases.text: Find the class in the schedule, then list its reservations with the check-in state of each client.

useCases.title: Find the locations and rooms of the studio
useCases.text: List the studio locations, then list the rooms of one location.

useCases.title: Read clients changed since a given time
useCases.text: List clients, fetching only the ones changed since a given time. Open one client to read its contact fields.

useCases.title: Review client purchases and referrals
useCases.text: List the client purchases, the packages and subscriptions that reservations use. List the referrals from the studio referral program.

useCases.title: Book a client or check one in
useCases.text: Book one client into a class with one credit from a purchase, or mark a reservation as checked in. Both change live data.
